name: arduino-blink
description: Arduino (AVR Uno/Nano) sketch: blink + button + serial. Build/flash with arduino-cli.

files.content:
# Arduino Blink

1. Install the AVR core: `arduino-cli core update-index && arduino-cli core install arduino:avr`
2. Find your port: `arduino-cli board list` (e.g. COM5 or /dev/ttyUSB0)
3. Compile: `arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:avr:uno blink`
4. Upload: `arduino-cli upload -p COM5 --fqbn arduino:avr:uno blink`
5. Monitor: `arduino-cli monitor -p COM5 -c baudrate=115200`

Nano: use `arduino:avr:nano` (old bootloader: `arduino:avr:nano:cpu=atmega328old`). Button: pin 2 to GND.
